repos.name: bojieli/ai-agent-book
repos.description: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》（李博杰 著）开源主仓库：全书正文、编译版 PDF 与按章配套代码
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive open-source textbook detailing the design principles and engineering practices of AI agents.
bullets: Covers agentic architecture, planning, memory, and tool-use patterns.
Provides a structured engineering framework for building reliable autonomous systems.
Includes full text, PDF, and modular code examples for practical implementation.
Essential for developers building complex agentic workflows in enterprise environments.

repos.name: Tencent/WeKnora
repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.one_liner: An open-source LLM knowledge platform designed to transform raw documents into autonomous RAG and reasoning agents.
bullets: Built with Go for high-performance document processing and knowledge retrieval.
Integrates RAG pipelines with autonomous reasoning capabilities for self-maintaining wikis.
Automates the conversion of unstructured data into queryable, structured knowledge bases.
Ideal for enterprise knowledge management and automated research workflows.

repos.name: bojieli/ai-infra-book
repos.description: 《深入理解 AI Infra：量化分析与系统设计》（李博杰 著）开源书稿：从硬件约束和模型架构出发，量化推导 LLM 推理与训练系统设计。含全书正文、PDF、配套计算工具与实验
repos.one_liner: A deep-dive technical book on AI infrastructure, focusing on quantitative analysis and system design for LLM training and inference.
bullets: Analyzes hardware constraints and model architectures to optimize compute performance.
Provides quantitative derivations for scaling LLM training and inference systems.
Includes配套 (companion) calculation tools and experimental benchmarks.
Critical resource for infrastructure engineers optimizing large-scale AI deployments.

repos.name: shadcn-ui/lint
repos.description: An agent-first linter for Tailwind design systems. Write design system rules that agents can verify.
repos.one_liner: An agent-first linter for Tailwind design systems that enables automated verification of UI/UX rules.
bullets: Uses an agentic approach to enforce design system consistency across large codebases.
Allows developers to define custom design rules that AI agents can programmatically verify.
Reduces manual code review overhead for frontend infrastructure and design teams.
Integrates directly into modern TypeScript/Tailwind development workflows.

bullets: Modular TypeScript architecture supporting complex enterprise business logic.
